about_the_game:
NOTE: This game is developed by a 14 year old Persian boy

Enter a world of war, deception, and fate in Universal Power-Blade of Persia  DEMO. As Odysseus, a skilled warrior and strategist, you are sent on a critical mission to uncover the truth behind the Persian invasion of Greece. What starts as a reconnaissance mission quickly turns into a deadly game of survival, where stealth, wit, and combat prowess are your only weapons.

Navigate treacherous landscapes, infiltrate enemy strongholds, and strike from the shadows in this gripping prologue to an epic war.

The demo is about 45 minutes long.

Key Features:

⚔️ Stealth & Tactical Combat – Sneak past enemies, use the environment to your advantage, and strike with deadly precision.

🔥 Narrative-Driven Experience – Witness a cinematic story of war, loyalty, and sacrifice as you uncover the Persian empire’s true intentions.

🌍 Ancient World Brought to Life – Explore designed locations inspired by Greek and Persian architecture, filled with danger and intrigue.

The war has begun. The blade is drawn. Will you rise, or fall?

Play the DEMO now and experience the beginning of an unforgettable saga!

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-9600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 11 GB available space

short_description: Universal Power-Blade of Persia DEMO is an action-adventure stealth game where you play as Odysseus, a warrior on a mission to stop the Persian invasion. Infiltrate enemy camps, strike from the shadows, and make choices that shape Greece’s fate. Will you emerge victorious? Play now!
